name: Forced displacement
summary: IOM counts Sudan's displaced up by under 1% in October; no new event displacing 500,000 in a month found
state: IOM data for October show about 8.59 million internally displaced in Sudan, up by about 8,900 from September, with Blue Nile up 6% to 443,494 (allAfrica, 17 Nov). A humanitarian alert of 9 Nov counted about 166,500 newly displaced by fighting in South Kivu, DR Congo (Afrik.com). Searches on 28 Nov found no new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: People in Sudan's Blue Nile and Kordofan regions and in eastern DR Congo are most exposed to new displacement. Large movements tend to strain host communities and aid budgets in neighbouring areas.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month (largest found: about 166,500 in South Kivu)
